Hub FAQ

Hub booking questions

How much does it cost to book the DiscoveryTech Hub space?

The full-day rate is ₦80,000, and it is negotiable for multi-day bookings.

How many people does the space seat?

The space seats up to 22 people.

What is included in the booking?

Every booking includes constant power supply, air conditioning, a projector and screen, a PA system, and restroom facilities.

Is internet included?

No. Internet is not included, so please bring a personal hotspot for online sessions.

What kinds of events suit the space?

Co-working, training and workshops, executive meetings, presentations and pitches, team offsites, and seminars or small conferences of up to 22 people.

How do I book, and how quickly will I get a reply?

Fill in the booking form on this page. It opens WhatsApp with your details pre-filled and sends a copy to info@discoverytechhub.com. We confirm availability and pricing within 24 hours.

Where is the space?

The space is at Plot 740 Aminu Kano Crescent, Wuse 2, FCT Abuja, Abuja, Nigeria.
